name: ReadGZH
description: Remote MCP server that reads public WeChat Official Account (微信公众号) articles from an existing mp.weixin.qq.com URL and returns clean Markdown. Tools: readgzh.read, readgzh.search, readgzh.list, readgzh.list_by_account and readgzh.get (search and listing cover only ReadGZH's cache, not all of WeChat). Works anonymously with a small shared per-IP daily quota; an optional ReadGZH API key in the Authorization header raises the quota.
